{{short description|Nepalese Professor}}
'''Shankar Prasad Shrestha''' (Nepali: शङ्कर प्रसाद श्रेष्ठ; born July 13, 1959) is a Nepalese [[Professor]] of Physics at department of Physics, [[Patan Multiple Campus]], Lalitpur, [[Nepal]].<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.nepjol.info/index.php/JNPhysSoc/search/authors/view?firstName=Shankar&middleName=Prasad&lastName=Shrestha&affiliation=Department%20of%20Physics%2C%20Patan%20Multiple%20Campus%2C%20Tribhuvan%20University%2C%20Kathmandu&country= |title = Author Details &#124; Journal of Nepal Physical Society}}</ref> He did his Master of Science in 1984 from Tribhuvan University, PhD in 1999 from School of [[Material Science]] and Technology, [[Varanasi]], [[India]] and postdoc from [[Sungkyunkwan University]], South Korea in July 2001.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Shankar Shrestha Resume/CV {{!}} Tribhuvan University, Deparatment of Physics, Patan Multiple Campus, Faculty Member |url=https://tribhuvan.academia.edu/ShankarShrestha/CurriculumVitae |access-date=2026-02-25 |website=tribhuvan.academia.edu}}</ref> He is a member of [[Nepal Physical Society]] and [[American Physical Society]]. He is known as Physics educator and [[researcher]] of [[Material Science]]; particularly in the field of thin film<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/251079413|title=Properties of ZnO:Al Films Prepared by Spin Coating of Aged Precursor Solution|first1=Shankar|last1=Shrestha|first2=Rishi|last2=Ghimire|first3=Jeevan|last3=Jyoti Nakarmi|first4=Young|last4=Kim|first5=Sabita|last5=Shrestha|first6=Chong-Yun|last6=Park|first7=Jin-Hyo|last7=Boo|date=20 January 2010|journal=Bulletin of the Korean Chemical Society|volume=31|pages=112–115|accessdate=2 October 2018|via=ResearchGate|doi=10.5012/bkcs.2010.31.01.112|doi-access=free}}</ref> and [[Carbon nanotube]],<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/263625170|title=Electrical Characteristics of Carbon Nanotubes by Plasma and Microwave Surface Treatments|first1=Sang-Jin|last1=Cho|first2=Shankar|last2=Shrestha|first3=Soon-Bo|last3=Lee|first4=Jin-Hyo|last4=Boo|date=20 March 2014|journal=Bulletin of the Korean Chemical Society|volume=35|issue=3|pages=905–907|accessdate=2 October 2018|via=ResearchGate|doi=10.5012/bkcs.2014.35.3.905|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |doi= 10.1016/j.carbon.2009.08.029|title= Preparation and field emission properties of Er-decorated multiwalled carbon nanotubes|journal= Carbon|volume= 48|pages= 54–59|year= 2010|last1= Shrestha|first1= Sabita|last2= Choi|first2= Won Chel|last3= Song|first3= Wooseok|last4= Kwon|first4= Young Taek|last5= Shrestha|first5= Shankar Prasad|last6= Park|first6= Chong-Yun}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Shankar_Shrestha|title=Shankar Prasad Shrestha - Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu - Department of Physics|website=ResearchGate|accessdate=2 October 2018}}</ref> here in [[Tribhuvan University]], Kathmandu, Nepal.<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/317107684|title=Preparation and Characterization of Zinc Oxide Based Photoanode for Dye-sensitized Solar Cell using Delonix Regia Natural Dye Extract|first1=Leela|last1=Pradhan Joshi|first2=Yamuna|last2=Poudel|first3=Mim|last3=Nakarmi|first4=Pradip|last4=Raj Niraula|first5=Shankar|last5=Shrestha|date=22 May 2017|journal=Journal of Nepal Physical Society|volume=4|pages=1|accessdate=2 October 2018|via=ResearchGate|doi=10.3126/jnphyssoc.v4i1.17329|doi-access=free}}</ref>
